extract:
Nightwish formed in 1996 in Kitee, a small town in eastern Finland, and has remained active ever since as one of the defining bands of symphonic metal. The group was founded by keyboardist and songwriter Tuomas Holopainen, who originally envisioned an acoustic mood-music project around a campfire. He recruited guitarist Emppu Vuorinen and classically trained soprano Tarja Turunen, a schoolmate from Kitee. Turunen's operatic voice proved too powerful for the acoustic concept, and the project became a metal band. Drummer Jukka Nevalainen joined soon after. Holopainen drew on film scores, especially those of Hans Zimmer, as well as fantasy literature and the Finnish power metal of Stratovarius.

The debut, Angels Fall First (1997), released on the Finnish label Spinefarm Records, was still rough and partly acoustic, though tracks like Elvenpath pointed toward the band's direction. With bassist Sami Vänskä added, Oceanborn (1998) sharpened the sound into fast, keyboard-driven power metal with operatic vocals, yielding the fan favorite Stargazers, and the stand-alone single Sleeping Sun, written for the 1999 solar eclipse, became a European hit. Wishmaster (2000) topped the Finnish album chart and was captured live on From Wishes To Eternity. Bassist and vocalist Marco Hietala, formerly of Tarot, replaced Vänskä for Century Child (2002), whose male-female vocal interplay and larger orchestral scope were showcased in Ever Dream and a cover of Andrew Lloyd Webber's The Phantom of the Opera. The Over The Hills And Far Away EP featured a cover of Gary Moore's song.

Once (2004) was the band's international breakthrough. It used a full orchestra and choir, with arrangements by Pip Williams, and produced the singles Nemo and Wish I Had an Angel, the latter appearing in the film Alone in the Dark. The album went multi-platinum in Finland and charted widely across Europe. After the End of an Era tour, documented on the live release recorded at Helsinki's Hartwall Areena in 2005, the band dismissed Turunen with an open letter in October 2005, a public rupture that drew heavy press attention. Bless the Child - The Rarities gathered B-sides from this period.

Swedish singer Anette Olzon took over for Dark Passion Play (2007), released on Nuclear Blast internationally. It was led by the singles Eva and Amaranth and anchored by the nearly fourteen-minute opener The Poet and the Pendulum. Bye Bye Beautiful, a single widely read as commentary on Turunen's exit, followed in 2008. Olzon departed in 2012 and was succeeded by Dutch vocalist Floor Jansen of After Forever and ReVamp. Uilleann piper Troy Donockley, a contributor since Dark Passion Play, became a full member. Later releases include Imaginaerum (2011), Endless Forms Most Beautiful (2015), Human. :II: Nature. (2020), and Yesterwynde (2024).

Nightwish's success alongside Within Temptation and Epica helped define female-fronted symphonic metal as a commercial force in the 2000s. They are among the best-selling Finnish musical acts, and their template of cinematic orchestration, operatic vocals and fantasy imagery inspired a wave of bands across Europe. Hietala left in 2021 and was replaced by Jukka Koskinen, while Nevalainen had earlier stepped aside in favor of Kai Hahto. Holopainen remains the band's creative center.
title: Nightwish
